key_findings: SELF-CHECK PASSED: L1 Jul 21-26 at 1 guest = €382 total (€440 strike), exactly matching the user's screenshot anchor.

ROOT CAUSE of prior '2x over-read': Stephanie's listings price PER GUEST. €382/5n=€76/n is the 1-guest rate; at the mandated 4 guests it is €820/5n=€164/n. The prior '€166/night' was the 4-guest figure, not a DOM error.

L1 is NOT a launch-discount outlier. L2 (€169/n) and L3 (€158/n) are priced essentially the SAME as L1 (€164/n) at peak, all three carry the same peak discount badge, and all three drop the discount in shoulder. Pricing is consistent across her portfolio.
At peak, Stephanie (~€164/n @4guests) is ~34% below the (small) comp median (~€247/n) - she is materially underpriced vs comps for 4-guest stays.
Comp data is thin: 3 of 5 comps (C-Portia, C-HighEnd360, C-Eden) are delisted; C-Alison peak is a September proxy. Treat comp medians as low-confidence.
